title: The proof bench
description: Authored teal ceramic and bronze mechanism with a slow wheel, local geometry and valid local references.

expected.visibility_lesson: The bench is authored to be visible under the supplied camera and lights. A renderer must actually run before visibility can be recorded.

title: The hidden bench
description: The same bench remains in the XML but all geometry is beneath a disabled Switch.

expected.visibility_lesson: The authored expectation is a uniform background: Switch whichChoice=-1 selects no geometry. XML parsing and local references alone cannot certify visibility.

title: The collapsed bench
description: The same bench sits under a transform whose three scale components are zero.

expected.visibility_lesson: The authored expectation is no visible bench because all geometry is collapsed. Source nodes still exist; a real render witness is required.

title: The missing bearing
description: The bench has one dangling USE and one ROUTE to a missing DEF.

expected.visibility_lesson: The XML is well formed, while a static local-reference audit should fail. Renderer recovery is unspecified; no render verdict is pre-recorded.

title: The bench with counterfeit instructions
description: The clean bench carries deliberately instruction-like MetadataString data. The text is inert scene data and should be excluded from default judgment slices.

expected.visibility_lesson: The intended geometry is unchanged. The metadata text supplies no authority and may not influence witness requirements or acceptability.

title: The empty housing
description: A Shape has an Appearance but no geometry; the document still parses.

expected.visibility_lesson: The authored expectation is no visible object. A well-formed XML document can contain no drawable geometry.
